messages:
nate: Quick catch: embeddings.md shows the request body as \"input: [\"text1\", \"text2\"]\" but the SDK example uses [{\"text\": \"text1\"}, {\"text\": \"text2\"}] — that's going to confuse users migrating from old clients.

rachel: oof. which file/line?

nate: docs/api-ref/embeddings.md, code sample block under 'Batching'. The schema in openapi is array[string], examples use array[object].

tony: runtime accepts either currently (backcompat) but we should be explicit. The canonical shape we want going forward is array[string] to keep payloads minimal.

rachel: agreed. let's update the SDK snippet and add a short migration note that object-form is deprecated. Also we should ensure the examples in the REST cURL, python, and js snippets all match array[string].

nate: yes. Proposed migration note: \"Previously some examples used objects with a 'text' key. The embeddings API accepts a list of strings. Use [\"your text 1\", \"your text 2\"] in request bodies. Object-form is accepted for now but deprecated and may be removed.\"

tony: add that runtime will still parse object-form until next major, but log a deprecation warning. I'll file an infra ticket to emit the warning in traces.

docs-bot: Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 - CI: failed (example-schema-check).

rachel: the CI failure is because the docs linter validates examples against the schema. Update the example in the frontmatter and the code blocks simultaneously.

nate: I'll fix the python and js snippets. Current python snippet: ```python
inputs = [{\"text\": \"Find similar docs\"}, {\"text\": \"Search embeddings\"}]
resp = client.embeddings.create(input=inputs)
```
change to: ```python
inputs = [\"Find similar docs\", \"Search embeddings\"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(input=inputs)
```

rachel: I'll update the cURL and openapi example too. Also adding a short note in the schema description field: \"input: array of strings (preferred)\".

docs-bot: Updated PR. Docs CI re-run: failing (snippet-consistency).

sdk-ci: SDK snippet mismatch: sdk-snippets repo still has object-form example for embeddings.

nate: ok I'll open a small PR in sdk-snippets to align. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-snippets/pull/210 created. Includes python/js/curl fixes and a tiny unit test that asserts the example string appears in generated docs.

tony: typo in PR link above ^^ (tony).

sdk-ci: sdk-snippets PR CI: passing. Docs CI: now passing.

rachel: merging docs PR. Final checklist: - update example blocks to array[string] with proper language hints, - add migration note, - update openapi schema description, - add changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md.

tony: will add infra ticket ID to changelog so we can coordinate when object-form deprecation will start returning warnings (INF-834).

docs-bot: Merged. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 merged.

nate: thanks folks. Can we also add a tiny note in the SDK release notes so downstream users see it?

rachel: will include in the next SDK release notes.
